description: This file is a shell script used for managing debug tools in a software project. It includes functions for downloading, cleaning, and setting environment variables for various debug tools such as lsof, gperftools, strace, and gdb. The script handles log file setup, tool download, cleanup, and path configuration, and is tailored for a specific project environment with custom paths and licensing information.

methods.name: echo_t
methods.description: Logs a timestamped message to the log file.

methods.name: clean_debug_tool
methods.description: Cleans all or specific debug tools based on input.

methods.name: set_path_variable_lsof
methods.description: Sets PATH environment variable for lsof if directory exists.

methods.name: set_path_variable_gperftools
methods.description: Sets PATH and LD_LIBRARY_PATH for gperftools if directories exist.

methods.name: set_path_variable_strace
methods.description: Sets PATH environment variable for strace if directory exists.

methods.name: set_path_variable_gdb
methods.description: Sets PATH environment variable for gdb if directory exists.

methods.name: set_all_path_variables
methods.description: Calls all individual path setup functions for debug tools.
